children: said on Tuesday it signed a partnership deal with Brookfield
and AI infrastructure platform Radiant to jointly develop a data centre exceeding 1 gigawatt at its northern England power station.

Drax will provide powered land and generation capabilities from its 4GW grid access at Drax Power Station, while Radiant brings AI infrastructure expertise and Brookfield supplies investment capital through a joint venture with Qatar's Qai announced in 2025, it said in a statement.
"If constructed in full, this project could become one of the largest data centres in the UK," Drax Group CEO Will Gardiner said.
Drax said Brookfield estimates the total potential investment could exceed £20 billion ($26.81 billion), with an initial £2.5 billion for the first phase.
The first phase, which will use power directly from the grid, is targeting commercial operations from early 2028, the British power firm added.
